title: Design System: OlaOlu. — Personal Research Institution

display.purpose: Hero wordmark and project names only. Uppercase, tight tracking.

motion.name: ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: All reveals and the preloader bloom.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase 10px sans wayfinding link; blurs on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'sc', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #171717; text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 8px; transition: filter 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: crosshair; } .ds-nav-link:hover { filter: blur(2px); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Link
components.description: The signature monument: giant serif wordmark, siblings blur on hover.
components.css: .ds-prj-link { display: block; font-family: 'pr', serif; font-size: clamp(1rem, 1rem + 6vw, 7rem); line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: -0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #171717; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: crosshair; transition: filter 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-prj-link:hover { filter: blur(0); } .ds-prj-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-prj-siblings { filter: blur(2px); }

narrative.overview: A white gallery wall, one enormous serif word at a time. The site treats each company name, each paper, each essay as a monument carved in near-black ink on a white field — big enough to read at a glance, quiet enough that the visitor's only task is choosing which monument to walk toward. Depth is never rendered with shadows; it is rendered with blur — the hovered name snaps into focus while its siblings fall out of it, the preloader blooms from blur into clarity, and the page itself resolves from soft fog on load.
keyCharacteristics: Monument-scale uppercase serif display type (up to 28vw on the hero wordmark)
White paper / near-black ink, with gray reserved for meta-labels and hairlines
Blur is the depth language — hover, preloader, and page reveal all use it
No border radius anywhere; sharp, uncompromising edges
Crosshair cursor on every interactive element
Image previews float at the bottom-right on project hover; siblings blur

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page is chromatic. Every project wordmark — company or otherwise — is ink on paper; the two non-company projects are distinguished by type alone (Education carries its Harvard shield). If a moment needs emphasis, use size or weight, never hue.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Only the serif speaks loudly. Any text that must be quiet is set in the sans, in gray, in uppercase, or all three. When in doubt, make it smaller and grayer.

dos: Do set every project name in the giant serif — the monument scale is the brand.
Do use blur for all depth and state changes; it is the system's material.
Do keep backgrounds pure white and text near-black; gray is for meta only.
Do use the crosshair cursor as the default pointer.
Do keep hairline dividers as the only separators — never cards or boxes.
Do link every project to its live site; the work speaks for itself.
donts: Don't add border radius, shadows, or colored surfaces — the system is flat and square.
Don't introduce any chromatic color — no green, no red, no accents (The Ink-Only Rule).
Don't render two loud type voices at once; if the serif is present, everything else whispers.
Don't introduce buttons, pills, or gradient text.
Don't blur on hover for users with reduced motion — the media query must keep links readable.
